name: Streptozocin

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for kidney harm, blood problems and cancer risk

examples.title: Avastin, Fluorouracil, Doxorubicin and Streptozocin in Locally Advanced and Metastatic Pancreatic Endocrine Tumors
examples.why: Development of new chemotherapy standard of care for treatment rendered the trial obsolete.

summary: In the United States, Streptozocin carries a boxed warning, which is the most serious type of warning, for kidney damage, blood problems, and the risk of developing cancer [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a low score of 23 for liver concerns and a low score of 16 for heart concerns [M]. A clinical trial studying this drug for advanced pancreatic tumors was ended because newer cancer treatments made the study outdated [5].
